## Why visit

The canal-side branch offers a spacious, modern counterpart to Cask on Liverpool Road. Its cask and cider provision means the trip need not become an all-keg brewery circuit when exploring New Islington. German beer and local modern beer broaden the choice, while booths and a dartboard keep the setting approachable. Include it when already spending time around Ancoats or the Piccadilly breweries; it makes a good change of pace between industrial taprooms and the northern centre’s historic pubs.

## Beer

CAMRA describes six handpulls with typically four cask beers and a cider, plus a substantial keg range.

## Plan the visit

Canal-side outdoor seating is an optional extra; plan November around the indoor bar. Distinguish this branch from Liverpool Road.

**Getting there:** Use New Islington tram stop or walk from Ancoats; combine with the Piccadilly brewery area.
